title: Dealer diagnosis follow-up
summary: This topic centers on customers being advised to have dealers further diagnose issues, with only a few fragments describing clear dissatisfaction and many giving inconclusive service-planning statements.

negative.summary: Negative feedback describes unresolved problems needing further dealer diagnosis and a noise issue that took a long time to identify.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback notes a recommendation to involve the dealer for diagnosis without enough detail to separate any benefit from the underlying concern.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback mostly states that the customer was advised to seek dealer diagnosis or plans to ask about a possible issue, without a clear opinion of the vehicle or service outcome.

limitations: Most fragments are brief procedural statements about seeking diagnosis, so many do not reveal a clear sentiment or outcome.
The cluster includes both dealer-diagnosis advice and one fragment about consulting the manual, which reduces topical coherence.
Examples are insufficient to identify the specific underlying faults beyond isolated mentions such as noise and a possible seat concern.
